🌾 FarmManager

Manage a farm from planting to harvest. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Plant crops in available plots — each has a growth time.
  2. Water and tend crops to maximize yield.
  3. Harvest when ready and sell at the market.
  4. Reinvest profits into more plots, better seeds, or farm upgrades.
  5. Seasonal crops have different prices — plan your planting schedule.
